summary: Fourteen days to Expo. Ridgeline escalated this morning: nine trucks double-booked at Reno, CFO copied, call wanted before noon. Reno sync errors reached 4.2%. Ranking is merged and going into the scoring API. Slot picker design is frozen. Harbor reliability plan sent; QBR is Thursday.

items.text: Omar (Ridgeline) wants a call before noon today about 9 trucks double-booked at Reno DC, with drivers waiting at the gate. Third incident this quarter. He copied Ridgeline's CFO.
Jordan logged a fix for the Reno double-bookings, owned by Arjun, high priority, 4h estimate, due today.
Reno sync errors were 4.2% overnight, all duplicates, same pattern as TW-103. That is far above the 1% target. TW-103 is still todo with no due date.
Smart Slots remains the company focus until Expo on Nov 4. Sync work was deferred unless sync worsened; Reno errors spiked overnight. Harbor export limit fix is done.
Ridgeline is yellow health and renews Nov 20 (22% of revenue). Today's double-booking escalation adds pressure. Renewal prep TW-113 is due Nov 13.
Ranking PR #232 was approved and merged (TW-129, TW-116 done). Arjun is wiring the merged ranking into the scoring API; TW-115 is due Oct 28.
Retry queue is running in staging (TW-104, no due date). Nina moved the sync error alert TW-105 to in progress.
Nina is on call this week and owns TW-105 (in progress), TW-103 (todo) and the Reno duplicate investigation. The Harbor UTC fix and ranking merge are finished.
Slot picker design is frozen as of today; Sam agreed to no further design changes. Leila says changes after Monday would not make it in.
Leila says the booth tablet flow uses the real slot picker, which must be stable by next Wednesday (Oct 28). TW-117 due Oct 29; new TW-135 error states due Oct 29; tooltips TW-123 in progress.
Demo screens 1 and 2 are done; screen 3 needs the slot picker build. Jordan got Coastal's anonymized booking data from Grace, to be shown on the demo screen. TW-119 due Oct 30.
Maya promised Sam the final pricing numbers by Friday (Oct 23). Sam is waiting on them for the printed one-pager.
Harbor QBR is Thursday Oct 22. Jordan's deck is drafted, with final numbers tomorrow morning. First weekly usage report went to Dana (TW-106 done).
Maya sent Dana the written reliability plan (TW-131 done). Harbor renewal is due Oct 30; order form sent, Dana called it routine. The timezone bug is fixed (TW-130, TW-132).
Coastal kickoff call is Thursday Oct 22. Valley is still waiting on data access. Both need to be live before Expo; TW-121 due Oct 30.
Coastal and Valley need endpoint docs before going live. TW-127 is not started, due Oct 26.
Third design partner Pinecrest is still unsigned and wants a live demo first. Three live partners are needed by launch. TW-126 due Oct 30.
Booth design reviewed today: one-line back wall, live demo on the big screen, tablet booking station. Lead list of 40 in progress, invites go out Friday; TW-122 due Oct 28.
Arjun has backend candidate interviews Thursday and Friday. He also reviews all backend PRs.
Maya's October investor update is in progress, due Oct 23.
